# Checkpoint

Issue: cloned entities retain technical fields.

Implemented `removeTechnicalFields<E extends SomeEntity>(entity: E): void` in `src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts`. It mutates the entity recursively, deleting own enumerable keys starting with `_finalEncrypted`, `_defaultEncrypted`, or `_errors` while preserving other properties. A WeakSet handles shared references and cycles. Added tests in `test/tests/api/common/utils/EntityUtilsTest.ts` for root fields, nested objects and arrays, and an entity without technical fields.

diff --git a/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts b/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts
index 95c62f2..6d1d79f 100644
--- a/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts
+++ b/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts
@@ -219,6 +219,30 @@ export function create<T>(typeModel: TypeModel, typeRef: TypeRef<T>): T {
 	return i as any
 }
 
+/**
+ * Removes metadata from a cloned entity before it is used as a new entity.
+ * The result is unsuitable for updating the original entity.
+ */
+export function removeTechnicalFields<E extends SomeEntity>(entity: E): void {
+	const visited = new WeakSet<object>()
+
+	function removeFromObject(value: object): void {
+		if (visited.has(value)) return
+		visited.add(value)
+
+		const fields = value as Record<string, unknown>
+		for (const key of Object.keys(fields)) {
+			if (key.startsWith("_finalEncrypted") || key.startsWith("_defaultEncrypted") || key.startsWith("_errors")) {
+				delete fields[key]
+			} else if (fields[key] !== null && typeof fields[key] === "object") {
+				removeFromObject(fields[key] as object)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	removeFromObject(entity)
+}
+
 function _getDefaultValue(valueName: string, value: ModelValue): any {
 	if (valueName === "_format") {
 		return "0"
